notes.title: Star Goddess v0.9 - Major Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I just uploaded a major Update. All goddesses are included now!!!.
Besides the goddesses added, I added in-game translations for English, Español, Japanese, Deutsch, Russian, and Français. The translations were made  with software translation program, if you find some translation errors, please let me know (hesperidesgames@gmail.com).

Enjoy!

notes.title: Release Early Access v0.4.2 - Beware the Asteroids!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The new release is up today.
The following has been changed / updated / fixed:

 NOW YOU CAN CRASH ON ASTEROIDS!!! BEWARE!! (but, not only you, the enemy ships and bullets, can collide with them too!!!)
 NEW DIFFERENT BACGROUNDS for the goddesses!
 NEW GODDESS!!! Moka, the carefree neko.
 Added master volume for better volume control. Now there are 3 volumes (Music, Sound effects, and Master)
 Changed crosshair for better visibility
 When you die, you will loose all the weapon upgrades, but leaving 3 random powerups behind.
 Some ships are changed depending on the difficulty
 The player ship hit box, has been reduced a little
 Now the powerups start flashing before disapearing
 Fix some bugs with the shooting and enemy spawning
 Fix Asteroids clipping goddesses
 Fix "Can't get powerups right after I respawned "


Ok, I let you enjoy these new features!!!, And... I go back to work for the next release...

Let me know your thoughts....
